topics.title: Joan Rivers Fuels Bowie-Jagger Rumors
topics.summary: Following Joan Rivers’ comments about David Bowie and Mick Jagger, Angie Bowie became a subject of intense media interest due to alleged infidelity rumors. The Daily News featured an image of her alongside the musicians, stemming from miscommunication regarding a reporter's attempt to elicit details about the rumored affair.

topics.title: Bowie & Angie's Shocking Revelation
topics.summary: During an interview, Howard and Angie discuss Tom’s obsessive golf tee time behavior while revealing that David Bowie was involved with Angie. They speculate about the reasons behind Bowie’s actions and explore a potential connection to Mike Tyson’s recent child announcement, alongside discussions of Michael Levin's controversial views.

topics.title: College Professor’s Statements and Societal Concerns
topics.summary: During a radio discussion, a college philosophy professor made controversial statements perceived as racially insensitive while discussing societal issues outside of his academic role. The conversation then shifted to examples of successful Black figures and the implications for tenure following public speeches and forum participation.

topics.title: Bowie Rumors and Listener Reactions
topics.summary: During a radio show, host Howard Stern discusses rumors about David Bowie’s homosexuality while acknowledging delays in phone calls and listener excitement. Listeners use multiple devices as prompted on air, sharing bizarre anecdotes including conversations with zoo keepers and C-SPAN recordings, creating an unusually animated discussion.

topics.title: Jason’s West Hollywood Mishaps
topics.summary: Jason Gould struggles with his mother Barbara’s intrusive behavior and attempts at fitting in after moving to a gay neighborhood near West Hollywood clubs. He repeatedly causes awkward situations, such as dressing up like her at parties and attracting unwanted attention from neighbors, leading to strained communication and concerns about privacy.

topics.title: Strange Calls and Disturbing Commercials
topics.summary: The broadcast features unsettling phone calls detailing an incestuous family with explicit details, followed by bizarre commercials depicting a brother and sister engaging in sexual activity on television. A segment addresses the murder of a transgender man in the Bronx, discussing past harassment and judgmental attitudes towards LGBTQ+ individuals.
